name: svg-french-press-pareto-26.10-preview-s2-r3
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG. Use the standard three-piece plunger filter rather than a two-piece travel press.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 900 1420" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif">
  <defs>

      <stop offset="0.22" stop-color="#c6ccd3"/>

      <stop offset="0.72" stop-color="#cdd2d8"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#71767e"/>

    <linearGradient id="chromeV" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1="300" y1="0" x2="625" y2="0">

      <stop offset="0.25" stop-color="#bfc5cc"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#878e97"/>
      <stop offset="0.75" stop-color="#cdd2d8"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#71767e"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="plastic" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#565a61"/>
      <stop offset="0.45" stop-color="#2b2e33"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#14161a"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="glassGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#eef5f9" stop-opacity="0.18"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#c7d9e5" stop-opacity="0.42"/>

    <pattern id="meshPat" width="7" height="7" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <path d="M0 0 H7 M0 0 V7" stroke="#7d848d" stroke-width="1"/>
    </pattern>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="900" height="1420" fill="#fcfcfd"/>

  <!-- assembly axis -->
  <line x1="430" y1="52" x2="430" y2="1402" stroke="#c9cfd6" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="7 7"/>

  <!-- title -->
  <text x="450" y="40" text-anchor="middle" font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#22262b">French Press</text>
  <text x="450" y="66" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-style="italic" fill="#7a828c">Exploded assembly — standard three-piece plunger filter</text>

  <path d="M 330 1040 C 326 1120 322 1200 328 1258" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="10" opacity="0.35" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 356 1046 C 353 1120 351 1190 355 1246" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4" opacity="0.22" stroke-linecap="round"/>
